明確把 autumn 當作一個季節時段。 但本題的決定性線索是 mixed conditions between two seasons；這句真正要表達的是「由夏入冬的過渡性」。因此 autumn season 雖與 autumn 有關，地區用法、農業含義、季節功能或文體焦點並不最吻合。
美式英語中與 autumn 直接對應。 但本題的決定性線索是 mixed conditions between two seasons；這句真正要表達的是「由夏入冬的過渡性」。因此 fall 雖與 autumn 有關，地區用法、農業含義、季節功能或文體焦點並不最吻合。
聚焦收割、採摘與農作物成熟。 但本題的決定性線索是 mixed conditions between two seasons；這句真正要表達的是「由夏入冬的過渡性」。因此 harvest season 雖與 autumn 有關，地區用法、農業含義、季節功能或文體焦點並不最吻合。
文學／形象化地聚焦落葉與秋色。 但本題的決定性線索是 mixed conditions between two seasons；這句真正要表達的是「由夏入冬的過渡性」。因此 season of falling leaves 雖與 autumn 有關，地區用法、農業含義、季節功能或文體焦點並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者是最直接的地區變體；autumn 在英式英語較常見，fall 在美式英語較常見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Leaves turn red in autumn. Leaves turn red in the fall.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者常重疊，但 harvest season 只在收成活動明確時合適；並非所有作物都在秋天收成。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The farm is busy during harvest season. The days become shorter in autumn.

falseSynonyms.zh: late summer 仍屬夏季；它可能接近秋天，但不是 autumn 的同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The heat continued into late summer. Cooler weather arrived in autumn.

falseSynonyms.zh: early winter 已屬冬季，不能因天氣寒冷而當作 autumn。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Snow arrived in early winter. Leaves fell throughout autumn.

falseSynonyms.zh: autumn 是名詞；autumnal 是形容詞，表示具有秋季特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Autumn is my favourite season. The garden had autumnal colours.

falseSynonyms.zh: fall 作名詞可表示秋天，但作動詞則是『掉落／跌倒』；必須按詞性判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fall is beautiful in New England. Leaves fall from the trees.

falseSynonyms.zh: autumn equinox 是秋分這一個天文時間點，不是整個秋季。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The autumn equinox occurs in September in the Northern Hemisphere. Autumn lasts for a season.

falseSynonyms.zh: Indian summer 指秋季中一段異常溫暖、乾燥的天氣，不等於整個 autumn。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We had an Indian summer in October. Autumn had already begun.
